hook.title: 7 hours a day on my *phone* and I can't *quit*

beats.text: 7h 40m on my phone today. How do I quit?
beats.say: Seven hours forty on my phone today. How do I quit?

beats.text: Another tip won't help. This is night twelve.
And you're asking me from your phone.
I tried grayscale. Night three.
Step one. Give me numbers, not vibes.

panel.title: Numbers, not vibes
panel.html:
i'm on my phone a lot
Today

TikTok 4h 12m

Instagram 2h 05m

146 pickups

Most of it after 11 p.m.

beats.text: Fine. Pasting Screen Time.
Four hours of TikTok? Rude.
Mostly after eleven.
Step two. Make a Project. List what already failed.

panel.title: A Project that remembers
panel.html:
Instructions

Don't suggest what I already tried.

Grayscale: lasted 2 days
App timer: ignored 40 times
Phone in kitchen: walked to kitchen
no repeatsnight 12 remembered

beats.text: I ignored the app timer forty times.
Now I never suggest it again.
Step three. Tell me to ask questions first.

panel.title: Questions before tips
panel.html:
Ask me 3 questions before any advice.
What do you open first?What happens right before?Where's your charger?
Trigger: work email, in bed, 11:40 p.m.

beats.text: What happens right before you scroll?
I check work email. Then I need to calm down.
There it is.
Step four. One tiny plan. Make it an artifact.

panel.title: One plan, not twelve
panel.html:
Email off after 9 p.m. Charger in the hallway.
Night 1 of 7

beats.text: Just one thing? Add a few more tips.
You tried twelve. None stuck.
Done. Phone's charging in the hallway.
Then what are you typing on?
The iPad.
